## Summary

Describe what this pull request changes and why.

## Verification

List the commands or manual checks used to verify the change.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and does not include unrelated edits.
- [ ] Tests cover new or changed behavior where appropriate.
- [ ] Documentation and types are updated where appropriate.
- [ ] A changeset is included for publishable package changes.
- [ ] `npm run format:check`, `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, and `npm test` pass.
- [ ] I agree to follow the Code of Conduct.
